packageRules.description: Every Kotlin artifact and plugin marker shares the `kotlin` version ref, so they can only move as one. The [.:] guard is load-bearing: it admits `org.jetbrains.kotlin:` and `org.jetbrains.kotlin.<plugin>:` while rejecting `org.jetbrains.kotlinx`, whose next character is `x`. Without it coroutines, datetime, io, serialization and binary-compatibility-validator are dragged into this group despite releasing on their own schedules.
prBodyNotes: A compiler bump can move the pinned klib ABI. `apiCheck` runs under `check`, so if CI fails on it, run `./gradlew :marine-api:apiDump` and commit the diff -- that diff is the review artifact.

packageRules.description: AGP drives the `agp` ref through its library entry, and a bump moves the Android target's toolchain under both :marine-api and :examples-android.
prBodyNotes: AGP owns the built-in Kotlin support this build depends on: :examples-android deliberately has no `kotlin-android` plugin, and KSP/Hilt attach to AGP's own compilation. Check `:examples-android:assembleDebug` and `:examples-android:testDebugUnitTest`, not just the library.

packageRules.description: Ignore Android Gradle Plugin marker lookups as they are handled by the library entry

dagger, hilt-android, hilt-compiler, hilt-core and the Hilt Gradle plugin all sit on the `hilt` ref; Hilt's own plugin needs 2.59 or newer to work with AGP 9, so this group is where that floor is felt.

Five artifacts on the `androidx-lifecycle` ref. Renovate can only raise a bump once every one of them has published the new version, so this group going quiet means one member is lagging rather than that lifecycle is current -- the Dependency Dashboard is where that shows.
activity and activity-compose share the `androidx-activity` ref.
navigation3-runtime and navigation3-ui share the `androidx-navigation3` ref.

coroutines-core and coroutines-test share the `kotlinx-coroutines` ref. Kept out of the Kotlin group above: coroutines ships on its own cadence, and the IO layer's flow behaviour is the part of this library most sensitive to it.
